usedFor: QuickHunt gathers feedback, and TRIGGERcmd runs “Trigger Command” on your computers when “New Feedback Received” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feedback Received” in QuickHunt, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: New feedback can start a command you have already set up on your own computers.

watchOut: “New Feedback Received” in QuickHunt is polling, so “Trigger Command” starts after a scheduled check.
